subtitle: Proposing changes to a repository you don't control at all

eyebrow: A fork is your own copy
caption: Full push access under your own account — no permission needed from the original owners.
GitHub defaults to comparing within one repo — this link is the door into the forking workflow.
Base: the original repo and branch. Head: your fork and your branch. Easy to flip by mistake.

code:
$ git remote add upstream https://github.com/original-owner/react.git
$ git fetch upstream
$ git checkout main
$ git merge upstream/main
$ git push origin main
caption: Your fork doesn't auto-update — pull from upstream yourself, periodically.
